name: Build Missing API Routes
description: Create all 6 missing REST API route files: events.ts, students.ts, teachers.ts, predictions.ts, admin.ts, parents.ts. Each route must use Zod validation, RBAC middleware, and proper error handling. Wire them into src/api/server.ts.

subtasks.name: Read existing patterns
subtasks.description: Analyze src/api/server.ts and middleware files to understand the existing Express setup pattern

subtasks.name: Build events route
subtasks.description: Create src/api/routes/events.ts with POST /events (ingest interaction events), GET /events/:studentId (list events). Use Zod validation for event body, requireRole('teacher','admin').

subtasks.name: Build students route
subtasks.description: Create src/api/routes/students.ts with GET /students, GET /students/:id, GET /students/:id/mastery, GET /students/:id/brain-map. Use Zod params validation, requireRole middleware.

subtasks.name: Build teachers route
subtasks.description: Create src/api/routes/teachers.ts with GET /teachers/:id/dashboard, GET /teachers/:id/heatmap, GET /teachers/:id/risk-alerts. Wire to service layer.

subtasks.name: Build predictions route
subtasks.description: Create src/api/routes/predictions.ts with GET /predictions/:studentId, POST /predictions/batch. Return predictions with confidence bounds.

subtasks.name: Build admin and parents routes
subtasks.description: Create src/api/routes/admin.ts and src/api/routes/parents.ts. Admin gets system health endpoints, parents get privacy-safe CI-derived mastery views.

subtasks.name: Wire routes into server
subtasks.description: Update src/api/server.ts to import and mount all 6 new route files

subtasks.name: Generate API route tests
subtasks.description: Create tests/integration/api-routes.test.ts with supertest-based tests for all endpoints
